keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «로켓 연료가 모자라다(문제)» 와 «미나의 달 여행은 멋진 모험이다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the rocket is low on fuel) and the ending (Mina’s trip is a great adventure). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The rocket is low on fuel.
Mina flies home just in time.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: . On the Moon, she can jump very
rock. Then the rocket is low on
, so Mina flies home just in time.

words: a machine that flies into space
to fly up fast at the start
to come down from the sky onto the ground
what makes a rocket or a car go
Her trip to the Moon is a great adventure!

qs.q: Why does Mina run back to the rocket?
opts: The rocket is low on fuel.
evs: On the Moon, she can jump very high!
Captain Mina gets into her rocket.
why: 로켓이 «Low fuel!» 하고 울려요. 연료가 모자라서 서둘러 돌아가요.
The rocket beeps, "Low fuel!" So Mina runs back.

qs.q: "3, 2, 1, blast off!" What does "blast off" mean?
qs.qko: «3, 2, 1, blast off!» 에서 «blast off» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: the rocket starts to fly up
evs: The rocket shoots up into the dark sky.
Soon Mina lands on the Moon.
Her trip to the Moon is a great adventure!
why: «The rocket shoots up into the dark sky.» 바로 다음에 로켓이 하늘로 솟아올라요. 그러니 «blast off» 는 날아오르기 시작한다는 뜻이에요.
Right after "blast off," the rocket shoots up into the sky. So it means the rocket starts to fly up.

qs.q: Why is Mina’s trip a great adventure?
qs.qko: 미나의 달 여행은 왜 멋진 모험인가요?
opts: She jumps high on the Moon and gets home just in time.
She stays home and reads about the Moon.
She meets a monster on the Moon.
evs: On the Moon, she can jump very high!
Mina runs back and flies home just in time.
why: 달에서 아주 높이 뛰었고(«On the Moon, she can jump very high!»), 연료가 떨어지기 전에 아슬아슬하게 집에 왔어요(«Mina runs back and flies home just in time.»). 신나고 아슬아슬해서 멋진 모험이에요.
She jumps very high on the Moon, and she gets home just in time. It is fun and exciting, so it is a great adventure.

ends: Captain Mina flies to Mars next time.
Mina shows her shiny Moon rock to her friends.
미나는 친구들에게 반짝이는 달 돌을 보여 준다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my friend likes space)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my friend likes space)
write.src: “I want to <u>go to the Moon</u> because <u>I can jump very high</u>.”

img.cover: On the gray Moon under a black starry sky with the small blue Earth far away, a young girl with a black ponytail in a white space suit with a red stripe and a clear round helmet jumps very high with both arms up and a big smile, leaving deep footprints in the dust below, next to a tall red and white rocket.

scenes.1: On the gray dusty Moon, a young girl with a black ponytail in a white space suit with a red stripe and a clear round helmet kneels and holds up a sparkling shiny rock with wide happy eyes, while a tall red and white rocket stands behind her and the small blue Earth glows in the black sky.
scenes.2: Inside a tall red and white rocket with a blinking red warning light on the control panel, a young girl with a black ponytail in a white space suit with a red stripe and a clear round helmet grips the controls with a brave face as the rocket zooms through space toward the big blue Earth.

alt.1: Mina finds a shiny rock on the Moon.
alt.2: Mina flies the rocket home to Earth.
